# AirlinePlanes
# A directory of commercial aircraft and the airlines that fly them.

> AirlinePlanes helps travelers understand what planes they fly on.
> Browse aircraft specs, explore airline fleets, and compare aircraft
> from Boeing, Airbus, Embraer, Bombardier, and more.

## Pages
- / — Homepage with featured airlines and aircraft
- /aircraft — Browse all aircraft with manufacturer filters
- /aircraft/[slug] — Aircraft detail page with specs, history, and airlines
- /airlines — Browse all airlines with fleet stats
- /airlines/[slug] — Airline detail page with fleet breakdown
- /manufacturer — Browse aircraft manufacturers
- /manufacturer/[slug] — Manufacturer detail page with aircraft lineup
- /about — About AirlinePlanes
- /sources — Data sources and citations

## API
- /api/aircraft — List aircraft (supports ?search, ?manufacturer)
- /api/aircraft/[slug] — Single aircraft detail
- /api/aircraft/[slug]/history — Aircraft history entries

## Feeds
- /feed.xml — RSS feed of latest aircraft additions
- /sitemap.xml — XML sitemap

## Full Data
- /llms-full.txt — Complete database dump with all aircraft specs and content
